meaning: Making a call or text look like it came from a different number or name. Crooks use it to trick you into answering.
clues: Someone is pretending to be something they are not.
It happens with phone calls or text messages.
The number or name on your screen is not the real one.
Crooks use it so you will answer, thinking it is a local number, a bank, or someone you know.
It has eight letters and starts with S.
assumes: A robocall plays a recorded message
Catfishing is pretending to be someone else online

decoys.meaning: A phone call that plays a recorded message instead of a live person.
Pretending to be someone else online, with a fake name and fake photos, to fool a person.
Someone uses your name or account numbers without your permission, such as to buy things in your name.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, if the phone said Mom, it was Mom. Now the screen can fib.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Caller ID can be faked. If a call claims to be your bank, hang up and call the number on your card.
